notes: Live Activities ab bilkul Telegram group chat jaisi: Inward/Outward Gate Pass banana, photo/video/document lagana, voice note, swipe reply, @mention, long-press menu. Gate pass ki print/PDF mein document ke saath saari pictures ek hi PDF mein. My Space: profile photo ab bari hero photo hai jo scroll karne par chhoti gol avatar ban kar upar chipak jati hai; options ab saaf list rows mein hain.
releaseNotes: Flashy v2.22: (1) Live Activities ka pura Telegram group-chat clone — ERP ke apne rang/theme ke saath: bubbles, sender ke naam rang ke saath, date pills, reply quote, blurred undownloaded media + download button, voice waveform player, photo albums, 'Message' composer (attach sheet, mic/send), scroll-down button, long-press menu (Reply/Copy/Save/Delete from device). (2) Gate Pass: attach sheet se Inward/Outward Gate Pass banta hai — party, vehicle, driver, items, remarks, caption, pictures/videos — group mein document card ban kar post hota hai; Print/Save par gate pass document + saari pictures (video ka poster frame) EK hi PDF mein, Print Studio ke andar. Kuch bhi ERP database mein save nahi hota — sab Telegram group mein rehta hai. (3) My Space profile hero: photo full-bleed, neeche gradient blur; scroll par smooth morph — gol avatar upar pinned + naam; options (My Profile/Payslip/Attendance/Requests) ab icon+label+chevron rows mein. Verification: pure harness 28/28, multipart capture 12/12, live group E2E (text/reply/mention/gate pass in+out, photo, voice — receipts + cleanup + zero-Supabase proof), Chromium probe 25/25.
